title: -Describe prints the configuration surface, the exit-code contract and the unsupported list
titleZh: -Describe 打印配置面、退出码契约与明确不支持清单
why: defensive-spec section 1.3(d) and section 9.2: every override has to be discoverable and the things this plugin refuses to do have to be stated where a user will look. -Describe must also be probe-free: it exits 0 without a single judgement, which is what makes it safe to run first on an unknown machine.
expectSummary: exit 0 with the resolution order, the exit-code contract and the NOT-supported list; no report is produced
